description.value: Kokoro Tokyo Mazesoba is a Japanese restaurant chain specializing in mazesoba, a rich, broth-free saucy noodle dish that originated in Nagoya and was popularized in Tokyo by founder Takuma Ishikawa when he opened his first shop in 2014. The Brentwood location is one of several BC outposts of this internationally expanding brand, now operating across Canada, Singapore, the Philippines, and beyond. Touring cyclists will find a full menu of mazesoba, ramen, rice bowls, gyoza, and soft-serve ice cream, with confirmed vegan and vegetarian options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's /our-location page lists the Brentwood location at '106-1901 Rosser Ave, Burnaby, BC' with phone +1 (604) 973-1911 — confirming the address but contradicting the OSM phone (+1-604-416-4576), which the website assigns to the Metrotown location (6049 Silver Dr). OSM tags diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes are corroborated by the menu page listing a Vegetable Ramen and multiple plant-adaptable dishes; the /order-from-web page confirms online/takeout ordering for the Brentwood location. No bike parking, water refill, or Wi-Fi evidence appears on the website.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM phone +1-604-416-4576 is listed on the website as belonging to the Metrotown location (6049 Silver Dr, Burnaby), not this Brentwood location. The website assigns +1 (604) 973-1911 to 106-1901 Rosser Ave. OSM phone updated to website value.
OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the address (1901 Rosser Ave, V5C 6R6) and the website both place this location in Burnaby.
